title: Treatise on Spike and Haft Combination
summary: Joins the plain strokes of the spiked ball to qi-weighted follow-ups for a student who already steps with purpose.

title: The Swinging Burr Manual
summary: Teaches a student with a working guard to carry qi into the burr head through the whole length of a swing.

title: Guide to Breath-Weighted Spike Work
summary: Shows how breath timed to each swing adds weight to the spikes without tiring the shoulders early.

title: Canon of the Crushing Thorn Arc
summary: Gathers the heavy overhead and sweeping arcs of the thorned head for students who have reached Warrior.

title: A Warrior's Workbook for the Bristled Orb
summary: Offers a long course of drills linking qi-assisted strokes of the bristled orb to quick footwork.

title: Lessons in Barbed Head Control
summary: Trains control of where a barbed head lands and how it is recovered, using a thin thread of qi.

title: Treatise on Haft Leverage and Spike Bite
summary: Explains how the long shaft is used as a lever so the spikes bite and hold against armor.

title: Manual of the Rolling Spike Round
summary: Teaches a continuous rolling circuit of strikes and guards, with qi renewing each turn of the head.
